_README: Parameters a Qt GUI exposed that this branch's interface deliberately does
not, with the reason. Hand-maintained: unlike baselines/task-coverage.json
this file is never regenerated, because each entry is a judgement someone
An entry here is a decision not to do the work. An entry in the baseline's
gaps is work not yet done. Keeping them apart is the point -- otherwise a
closed question and an open one look identical, and the shrinking gap count
The test checks each entry still earns its place: the parameter must still
be declared by the task (so a rename does not leave a stale excuse) and
must still be unreachable (so an exclusion that someone has since
implemented gets removed rather than quietly contradicting the code).

reason: Developer scaffolding. Qt puts these behind
`if b1 or b2 or b3 or 'MRD_DEVEL' in os.environ:` -- shown only when one
is already set or the developer environment variable is present -- and
labels the section with the tooltip 'There is a bug if you see this
section'. MOCK_DIR starts the job from a copy of an existing work
directory; the two pauses are for watching it run. None belongs in a
form a crystallographer uses.
Steps the SHELX pipeline does not run. crank2_basepipe.py sets
shelx_steps = [substrdet, phdmmb, building, ref] against
crank2_steps = [substrdet, phas, handdet, dmfull, building, ref], and
gates hand determination on `CheckStartEnd('handdet') and not SHELXCDE`.
SHELXE does the density modification, the poly-Ala tracing and the hand
discrimination itself inside the phdmmb step -- the hand parameter shelx
does expose is PHDMMB_THRESHOLD_HAND_STOP, 'Other hand CC threshold'.
These appear in the Qt reference only because CTaskCrank2 creates the
widgets unconditionally and hides them at run time through
toggleFunction=[self.basepipe.ToggleHandDetermination, ...], which a
static read of the GUI cannot evaluate. Adding them would put fields on
screen that no shelx run can use.
Substructure detection options specific to prasa. Qt gates every one of
them on `toggle = ['SUBSTRDET_PROGRAM', 'open', ['prasa']]`, and shelx
detects with shelxd -- SUBSTRDET_PROGRAM is one of the parameters
CTaskCrank2 withholds from shelx under `if self.TASKNAME != 'shelx'`.
